basic_info.description: Pride of ownership, boutique building is for sale for the 1st time in 37 years. Perfect Russian Hill location which tenants find very desirable and good rental history. Six 2 bd/1/ba units, 2 per floor, flexible floor plans, hardwood floors, high ceilings, nice details. Also, 2 ADU's - 2 bd/1.5 ba and 1bd/1ba (square footage of ADUs is not included in the tax records figure). Coin-op washer/dryer, nice lobby, garden, professional management. Great property to add to any investor's portfolio. Do not disturb tenants.
